description: This file defines an ExtensionLoader class for managing extension entry points, including loading and retrieving extensions for core, provider, and obbject groups within the openbb platform. It uses enums, caching, and dynamic loading of modules.

classes.name: OpenBBGroups
classes.description: An enumeration class defining extension groups for openbb core, provider, and obbject.

classes.name: ExtensionLoader
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for loading and managing extension entry points and objects for different groups.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Returns a list of all extension group names.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ExtensionLoader, setting up entry points for each group.

methods.name: obbject_entry_points
methods.description: Returns the entry points for obbject extensions.

methods.name: core_entry_points
methods.description: Returns the entry points for core extensions.

methods.name: provider_entry_points
methods.description: Returns the entry points for provider extensions.

methods.name: entry_points
methods.description: Returns a list of all entry point groups.

methods.name: _get_entry_point
methods.description: Retrieves a specific entry point by name from a list of entry points.

methods.name: get_obbject_entry_point
methods.description: Returns a specific obbject entry point by name.

methods.name: get_core_entry_point
methods.description: Returns a specific core entry point by name.

methods.name: get_provider_entry_point
methods.description: Returns a specific provider entry point by name.

methods.name: obbject_objects
methods.description: Lazily loads and returns a dictionary of obbject extension instances.

methods.name: core_objects
methods.description: Lazily loads and returns a dictionary of core extension instances.

methods.name: provider_objects
methods.description: Lazily loads and returns a dictionary of provider extension instances.

methods.name: _sorted_entry_points
methods.description: Returns sorted entry points for a given group.

methods.name: _load_entry_points
methods.description: Loads and returns a dictionary of extension objects based on entry points and group.
